column1: # Task-time artifacts a plain dependency resolve does NOT pull, but an offline build
# still needs. One per line, tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# group                             artifact                version   classifier      ext   hosts
# aapt2 version follows each project's AGP version, so the script derives it per project
#   com.android.tools.build:aapt2:<agp-aapt2-version>:<linux|windows>   (per build-host OS; ARM on-device uses Code on the Go's own aapt2)
# R8/D8: no separate artifact for the add-ons' AGP 9.3.1 : it ships inside
#   com.android.tools.build:builder:9.3.1, which a normal resolve captures. Older AGP
#   (8.4 K2Go, 8.8 CoGo) may reference com.android.tools:r8 separately; pin it via an
#   offline assemble oracle if/when the full offline BUILD of those ships (separate ticket).
# AGP versions in use: 8.4.1 (Knowledge to Go), 8.8.2 (Code on the Go), 9.3.1 (add-ons).
